ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Domain-contrastive routing loss in a mid-sized MoE
PROPOSAL: Pre-train an MoE with 500M active and 4B total parameters on 100B tokens of English and Chinese web text, adding a contrastive term that pulls together router outputs of tokens sharing a source domain and separates them from other domains, weighted 0.01 against the language modeling loss. Measure validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, plus expert overlap as the cosine similarity of expert outputs on probe batches.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; global-batch load balancing; router orthogonality regularizer; 2 seeds for the plain baseline to estimate run-to-run noise.
COST: 800
PREDICTION: Overlap drops and MMLU rises by about 1 point. It could fail if source domains are coarse, so the term merely duplicates load balancing.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Mutual-information term linking expert choice to domain tags
PROPOSAL: Train an MoE with 1.2B active and 8B total parameters for 12B tokens of English and Chinese web text, adding a term that raises mutual information linking the selected expert and a coarse domain tag, weighted 0.01 against the language modeling loss. Measure validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE at 3 checkpoints, plus expert overlap as the cosine similarity of expert outputs on probe batches.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; global-batch load balancing; router orthogonality regularizer; shared-expert variant with matched parameter count; 2 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 800
PREDICTION: Overlap drops and C-Eval rises by about 1 point. It could fail if tags carry little signal, leaving routing close to the uniform baseline.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Expert-diversity penalty on gate-weighted outputs
PROPOSAL: Add a penalty to an MoE with 300M active and 2B total parameters that lowers the cosine similarity of mean outputs among expert pairs, computed on each training batch and weighted 0.005 against the language modeling loss. Pre-train on 30B tokens of bilingual English and Chinese text with a standard router. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and track how often experts receive the same tokens as their nearest neighbour.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; penalty on router weights instead of outputs; variant with 2 always-active shared experts; 3 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 150
PREDICTION: Neighbour overlap should fall by a third and GSM8K gain about 2 points. It may fail if the penalty pushes experts apart without making them useful, which would show as higher perplexity.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Router entropy schedule with a specialization bonus
PROPOSAL: Train an MoE with 150M active and 1B total parameters on 20B tokens of English and Chinese text. Add a bonus that rewards low entropy of the routing distribution for a token given its domain, annealed from 0.02 to 0 during training, on top of the usual load-balancing loss. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and measure how often experts are chosen in 4 coarse domains.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; the bonus with constant weight; auxiliary loss on router orthogonality; global-batch load balancing; 3 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 150
PREDICTION: Domain usage becomes more peaked and RACE improves by about 1 point. It could fail if annealing releases specialization late, leaving final experts close to the baseline.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Specialization loss from gradient similarity of experts
PROPOSAL: Pre-train an MoE with 1B active and 8B total parameters on 150B tokens of English and Chinese text mixed with math and exam-style data. Add a loss that lowers the cosine similarity of gradients flowing into expert pairs, estimated from 64 sequence samples at each step and weighted 0.01. Compare validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and check training throughput to confirm that efficiency is preserved.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; global-batch load balancing; router orthogonality regularizer; version using activation similarity in place of gradient similarity; 2 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 2400
PREDICTION: Gradient similarity falls and GSM8K gains about 2 points with under 5 % throughput loss. It could fail if the sampled estimate is too noisy to guide experts.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Domain-balanced routing target for a compact MoE
PROPOSAL: Pre-train an MoE with 700M active and 5B total parameters on 40B tokens of English and Chinese text, mathematics and exam-style prose, with 2 seeds. Add a loss that matches the usage histogram of experts in each domain to a distinct target pattern fixed at the start, weighted 0.01 against the language modeling loss. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and measure expert overlap by cosine similarity of outputs.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; targets drawn at random instead of fixed by domain; router orthogonality regularizer; throughput measured for all arms.
COST: 2400
PREDICTION: Usage patterns split by domain and perplexity stays within 1 % of the baseline. It could fail if random targets perform as well, showing that structure rather than domain content matters.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Orthogonal expert subspaces through output projection loss
PROPOSAL: Train an MoE with 150M active and 1B total parameters on 25B tokens of English and Chinese text, adding a loss that keeps the output projections of experts near-orthogonal, with weight 0.01 against the language modeling loss. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and quantify expert overlap by cosine similarity of expert outputs on probe batches from 4 domains.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; the same loss on the router matrix; version with 2 shared experts; 3 seeds for the plain baseline.
COST: 60
PREDICTION: Overlap falls and MMLU rises by about 1 point. It could fail if orthogonal weights still produce similar outputs, since the loss acts on parameters rather than behaviour.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Token-cluster routing consistency loss with a frozen encoder
PROPOSAL: Pre-train an MoE with 100M active and 700M total parameters on 10B tokens of English and Chinese text. Cluster token embeddings from a frozen small encoder into 32 groups, then add a loss that encourages tokens in a group to share top-2 experts, weighted 0.02. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and compute expert overlap by cosine similarity of expert outputs.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; clusters assigned at random; router orthogonality regularizer; global-batch load balancing; 2 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 60
PREDICTION: Experts concentrate on cluster themes and MMLU rises by about 1 point. It could fail if frozen groups reflect surface form and not meaning, giving no benefit over random clusters.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Specialization-aware auxiliary loss with expert ablation check
PROPOSAL: Pre-train an MoE with 400M active and 3B total parameters on 60B tokens of English and Chinese text, adding a loss that penalizes the overlap of token sets received by expert pairs, weighted 0.01. After training, drop experts one at a time on validation data and record the perplexity change as a measure of how unique experts are. Evaluate perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE at 2 checkpoints.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; router orthogonality regularizer; global-batch load balancing; 2 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 400
PREDICTION: Dropping an expert should hurt more than in the baseline, and MMLU rises by about 1 point. It could fail if experts become unique yet less accurate, so benchmarks fall.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Token-overlap penalty on routed sets for an 8B-total MoE
PROPOSAL: Pre-train an MoE with 1B active and 8B total parameters on 9B tokens of English and Chinese text, adding a penalty on the overlap of token sets that expert pairs receive in a batch, weighted 0.01. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE at 4 checkpoints, and ablate experts one at a time on validation text to see how unique they are.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; penalty applied to top-1 choices only; router orthogonality regularizer; global-batch load balancing; 3 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 400
PREDICTION: Dropping an expert should hurt more than in the baseline, and RACE rises by about 1 point. It could fail if the penalty shrinks batch-level usage and degrades perplexity.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Hierarchical routing with a domain-level gate
PROPOSAL: Train an MoE with 800M active and 6B total parameters on 100B tokens of English and Chinese text, using a two-stage router that first assigns tokens to 4 expert groups and then to experts within a group, with a loss tying group choice to the source domain, weighted 0.02. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, plus expert overlap by output cosine similarity.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; flat router with the same loss on domains; router orthogonality regularizer; 2 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 1200
PREDICTION: Groups align with domains and C-Eval rises by about 2 points. It could fail if the group gate collapses to one group, leaving experts unspecialized.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Learned expert signatures with a sparsity-aware regularizer
PROPOSAL: Pre-train an MoE with 500M active and 4B total parameters on 30B tokens of English and Chinese text, with 2 seeds. Give every expert a learned signature vector, and add a loss that makes signatures of expert pairs dissimilar while tokens route by similarity to the signature, weighted 0.01. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and expert overlap by cosine similarity of outputs.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; router orthogonality regularizer; global-batch load balancing; signatures frozen at random initial values.
COST: 1200
PREDICTION: Signatures separate and GSM8K rises by about 2 points. It could fail if signatures drift apart yet outputs stay similar.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Domain-conditioned masking of experts during training
PROPOSAL: Pre-train an MoE with 300M active and 2B total parameters on 60B tokens of English and Chinese text. For tokens from a given source domain, mask the 2 experts used most by other domains with probability 0.3, which pushes the model to build alternatives. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and expert overlap by cosine similarity.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; masking of random experts regardless of domain; global-batch load balancing; 3 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 300
PREDICTION: Overlap falls and MMLU rises by about 1 point. It could fail if masking mostly lowers quality in the early phase, harming perplexity.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Contrastive objective on expert-routed token states
PROPOSAL: Train 2 seeds of an MoE with 200M active and 1.5B total parameters on 15B tokens of English and Chinese text, adding a contrastive loss on token states: positives are tokens routed to one expert, negatives are tokens sent to other experts, weighted 0.01. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and expert overlap by cosine similarity of outputs on probe batches.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; the loss with random expert labels; router orthogonality regularizer; global-batch load balancing.
COST: 300
PREDICTION: States of an expert cluster tightly and MMLU rises by about 1 point. It could fail if clustering only reflects routing, adding no new specialization.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Staged curriculum that sharpens routing after warm-up
PROPOSAL: Pre-train an MoE with 1B active and 8B total parameters on 200B tokens of English and Chinese text. For the first 20 % of steps use load balancing only, then switch on a specialization loss that lowers the cosine similarity of expert outputs, weighted 0.01. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and measure how expert overlap changes after the switch.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; specialization loss active from step 0; router orthogonality regularizer; global-batch load balancing; 2 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 3000
PREDICTION: Overlap declines after the switch and C-Eval gains about 1 point. It could fail if the late loss disturbs routing and perplexity rises.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Pairwise expert divergence loss on a compact MoE
PROPOSAL: Train an MoE with 600M active and 4B total parameters on 50B tokens of English and Chinese text, with 2 seeds, adding a loss that maximizes the divergence of output distributions for expert pairs on one input, weighted 0.01. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and track expert overlap by cosine similarity of outputs on probe batches.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; orthogonality regularizer on the router; global-batch load balancing; losses compared with 3 seeds.
COST: 3000
PREDICTION: Divergence rises and GSM8K gains about 1 point. It could fail if experts diverge on noise features, leaving benchmarks unchanged.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Layer-wise specialization loss in a small MoE
PROPOSAL: Pre-train an MoE with 200M active and 1.5B total parameters on 30B tokens of English and Chinese text, adding a specialization loss only in the last 4 layers, where expert outputs are compared by cosine similarity and pushed apart, weighted 0.01. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and expert overlap by layer on probe batches.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; loss in all layers; router orthogonality regularizer; 2 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 100
PREDICTION: Last-layer overlap falls and MMLU rises by about 1 point. It could fail if early layers drive specialization, so late-layer loss changes little.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Expert utilization entropy bonus with math-heavy data
PROPOSAL: Train an MoE with 100M active and 800M total parameters on 20B tokens of English and Chinese text and math problems, adding a bonus for lower entropy of routing given the data type, weighted 0.02 against the language modeling loss. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and expert overlap by cosine similarity on probe batches in 3 data types.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; the bonus applied to all tokens; global-batch load balancing; 3 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 100
PREDICTION: Math tokens concentrate on few experts and GSM8K rises by about 2 points. It could fail if concentration hurts balance, raising perplexity.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Expert-pair similarity regularizer with warm restarts of routing
PROPOSAL: Pre-train an MoE with 400M active and 3B total parameters on 100B tokens of English and Chinese text, adding a regularizer on the similarity of expert pairs measured from the mean output on a batch, weighted 0.01. Reset the router weights once at 30 % of training so that tokens can find new experts. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and expert overlap.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; regularizer without the router reset; global-batch load balancing; 2 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 600
PREDICTION: Overlap falls and MMLU rises by about 1 point. It could fail if the router reset erases early gains and perplexity rises.

ACTION: ADD
TITLE: Learned domain prototypes guiding the router
PROPOSAL: Train an MoE with 300M active and 2B total parameters on 40B tokens of English and Chinese text. Learn 8 prototype vectors, assign every expert to a prototype, and add a loss that pulls router scores of tokens toward the prototype of their nearest domain, weighted 0.01. Evaluate validation perplexity, MMLU, GSM8K, C-Eval and RACE, and expert overlap by cosine similarity of outputs.
CONTROLS: Load-balancing loss only; fixed random prototypes; router orthogonality regularizer; global-batch load balancing; 2 seeds for the baseline.
COST: 600
PREDICTION: Experts attach to prototypes and C-Eval rises by about 1 point. It could fail if prototypes collapse to one point, giving no structure.
